ratings_why.fun: Age as a routable resource gives real turns: play the Eldest fresh beside Netopir or sell old units into it via Echo Bat, and the oldest/youngest targets keep shifting under Painter and Novice.
ratings_why.distinct: Movable, spendable Age read by oldest/youngest targeting is new; the Long Sleep build still feels close to Hedgerow folk's turns-in-slot clocks.

verdict_why: Golden Echo Bat doubles Age on every sale, which chains into exponential Age for a few gold; one small fix, then it's ready.

points.text: Golden Echo Bat compounds: sell a 10-Age unit, a fresh buy gets 20, sell it, the next gets 40, so about 2 gold a doubling. Make the golden give the Age to your two youngest instead of doubling it.
The Eldest arrives with 0 Age, so it is your youngest: Echo Bat sales and a Netopir play feed it straight toward Awaken 20. Worth naming as the Relay's real line, since it is the tribe's best trick.

Seven-Month Dormouse empties itself each turn, so it stays youngest and soaks Beehive Painter's buff. Lovely unlisted combo; consider a Long Sleep card that also rewards being young, to give that build a decision.
The Robber-Knight plus Parkelj makes scouting the next board a real puzzle. A bat that swaps Age between two of your units would give that build a cheaper way to line up.

standouts.why: Brother Netopir turns already-awakened Age into a relay, and placement decides what flows where.
Beehive Painter links oldest and youngest, so who you feed and who you starve both matter.
Echo Bat makes selling an old unit a play, not a loss, and aims at whatever is youngest.

weakest.why: Kurent Bellman is a flat aura with no decision beyond where it sits.
Cloister Warden mostly matters in the half-Olm build; in the main builds it is filler.
Dragon of the Springs just counts total Age, the same job the Eldest does better.

flags.note: Golden Echo Bat doubles Age on each sale, so sale chains grow Age exponentially for gold alone.
Golden Netopir copies Age from nothing; linear, but feeds Hatchling, Dragon and the Eldest's Awaken fast.
Awaken 20 doubling the board once is a huge swing, reachable early via Netopir and Echo Bat feeding a fresh Eldest.
